bio: Naeem Ullah is a Full-Stack AI Engineer who builds AI products across model workflows, Python backends, APIs, interfaces, testing, automation, and deployment.

projects.name: XploitEye
projects.summary: Connects reconnaissance, authorized lab validation, remediation, web assessment, and retrieval-based security guidance.

projects.name: End-to-End Truck Dispatch Automation
projects.summary: Uses n8n, APIs, business rules, status tracking, and WhatsApp updates to automate a logistics dispatch workflow.

projects.name: AI-Generated Voice Detection
projects.summary: Evaluates real and synthetic speech with a compact classifier, API inference, visualizations, and an interactive demo.

projects.name: Cricket Ball Tracking & Delivery Analysis
projects.summary: Uses YOLOv5s, Kalman filtering, homography, and delivery classification in a single-camera computer vision pipeline.

projects.name: Legal AI & Document Retrieval
projects.summary: Connects document processing and retrieval to grounded legal-domain question answering.

projects.name: Incident Triage & Escalation
projects.summary: Structures incidents, routes them by severity, records acknowledgement, and escalates unresolved cases.

projects.name: AI-Assisted Fulfillment Workflows
projects.summary: Connects order review, shipments, tracking, activity history, and controlled conversational changes.

research.publication: Beyond the Naked Eye: Automated Delivery Analysis in Cricket with Computer Vision

clientWork: Naeem has delivered client and freelance work. Client names, private data, proprietary calculations, and internal business rules remain confidential.
automation: Experience includes n8n workflows, API integrations, validation, conditional business logic, error handling, and WhatsApp operational updates.
security: XploitEye demonstrates connected security workflows. Active validation is limited to authorized targets and deliberately vulnerable lab environments.
deployment: Experience includes containerization, CI workflows, Linux, and Azure Container Apps where a project requires them.
